spots.name: Boys Ranch, Oldham County
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 152 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L10422338.

spots.name: Coyote Bluff
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,088 m (3,570 ft).

spots.name: Bivins Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.
